findings.text: follow-on: the node authored a 54-line evidence fragment although its dispatch, whose done-when names no artifact, instructed it to write no evidence prose; the write is within the granted scope and harmless, but it is a deviation from the small-node contract.

follow-on: the done-when test's pass rests substantially on the _promote_record_holds repository requirement suppressing the promoted state for its repo-less fixture; the fleet_transitions hold the goal names is exercised only by the new test's repo-recording pointer, so the done-when alone does not exercise that hold.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base 60b808f5; the fleet_transitions loop moves the pop from the state word to absence from the observation, and _promote_record_holds now reads the promotion row from the run's recorded repository and returns False when the pointer records none.
item_verdicts.done_when: test_crew_ticker.py::test_ticker_emits_only_changes_and_ends_after_the_last_promotion passes and ends at head (2 passed, EXIT=0) and hangs at the reviewed base arm (EXIT=124); tests/test_a_promoted_live_run_does_not_reannounce.py::test_a_promoted_live_run_is_held_and_announced_once passes at head.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that fleet_transitions holds a promoted run whose live pointer remains; the fold now drops a run only when it is absent from the observation (if run_id not in current), and an independent replay showed base alternated promoted -> dispatched -> promoted every fold while head announced the landing once and then stayed silent.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the crew_ticker base arm hung at 60b808f5 (EXIT=124, completed false) and head 27 passed (EXIT=0), the new test 1 passed, the a_live_run_never_reads_dead file 1 failed/11 passed identically at base and head (zero added), the negative control EXIT=1, and honestly lists the pre-existing failure as a follow-on.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the commit touches exactly the three declared paths - reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_a_promoted_live_run_does_not_reannounce.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/a-promoted-live-run-does-not-reannounce.html - and no plan meta line; the declared docs/figures directory is unused.

justifications.durability: the change is committed at cd7b0fe8 with a substantive body, the fold docstring and both call sites' comments state the mechanism without a plan label, and the new test drives three folds and asserts the held state, not only the one event.
justifications.evidence: base arm hang (EXIT=124) and head pass (EXIT=0) both on disk with revision/tree/command headers, the re-announce reproduced standalone at base and shown silent at head, the declared mutation reddens the new test (EXIT=1, one failing id), and the production derivation reads the reviewed manifest's own suite logs as zero added.
justifications.fit: the pop-on-absence condition reuses the existing current/known set algebra, the repo requirement reuses ledger_module.run_path, and comments carry mechanism; the interaction between the two changes - the repo requirement suppresses the promoted word for a repo-less fixture - is real and correct but only partly explained.
justifications.goal_fidelity: salts independent replay of fleet_transitions over a promoted repo-recording pointer emits exactly one ('completed_unpromoted','promoted') and is then silent across two further folds, where the base emitted ('None','dispatched') on the second fold; the named re-announce is gone.
justifications.scope_discipline: the three changed paths are all within the granted scope and no plan meta was touched, but the node authored a 54-line evidence fragment although its dispatch stated its done-when names no artifact and it therefore writes no evidence prose.
